v: EXCELLENT. BRILLIANT. PERFECT sequel 🔥 Treasure hunt + mythology + logic without forcing one side down your throat. I was ready for Part 3 before credits ended 😄
e: Karthikeya 2 expands the original beautifully into a larger treasure-hunt adventure without losing the intellectual curiosity that made the first film interesting. Chandoo Mondeti keeps faith and scepticism in conversation with each other, then surrounds that idea with strong locations, cinematography, BGM and purposeful characters.
body:
EXCELLENT, BRILLIANT and a PERFECT SEQUEL!!!! Chandoo Mondeti is a worthy director and though the films after his debut with Karthikeya didn’t work out he bounced back with Karthikeya2!!!

If You watch a movie as a movie and doesn’t take sides between a Theist and Atheist, then this movie is enthrals you with superior Content based theme of Treasure Hunt with good dose of Thrill and Theist vs Atheist concept!!!

In few scenes the Theist concept takes upper hand and in few scenes Atheist concept gains upper hand but all this is done to take the story forward in a gripping way and this itself shows the intelligence of the Writer cum Director 🙏

Below are few specimen dialogues which justify both sides….

1. Devudini Poojinchatam kanna artham chesukotam avasaram!!!

2. Nenu Devudi dveshini kadhu….Satyanveshini!!!

3. Yella aythe Gudi gaa Devudini namadam thappo…allane gudi ga science ni namadam guda thape!!!

4. Dhenini Gudi ga Namakudadu….allani dhenini guda guddi ga namakunda kuda vundakudadhu!!!

and when such a gripping content gets support of the terrific cinematography , Terrific BGM and excellent locations then its a visual and audible treat to audience!!!!

Each and Every character had importance and relevance to the story and everyone of had done a great job in portraying those emotions….

I am a huge fan of Karthikeya 1 and the part 2 didn’t disappoint me even for a second….Now eagerly waiting for the 3 part of this franchise

v: Excellent idea, only above-average movie for me. First half rushed, second half saves it and Kalyan Ram carries almost everything 🙏 Blockbuster talk was bigger than my experience.
e: Bimbisara starts with a fresh reversal of the usual time-travel setup — sending a man from the past into the present — but rushes through too much of its promising first half. The second half works better and Kalyan Ram carries almost the entire film, making it an above-average watch rather than the knockout the concept could have delivered.
body:
I felt its OVERRATED!!! I generally have the tendency to ignore the talk around a film and completely get myself involved into all aspects of the movie and surprisingly my experience when compared to the general talk from what I read and heard….I felt its OVERRATED!!!

on paper the concept is excellent and less explored as generally most of the time travelling movies (at least which I am aware of) has the concept of a person from future travelling into the past, but someone from past coming into future is something new ( Aditya 369 has it covered partially)

With such a good concept in hand the director messed it up and was in hurry in the first half and second half saved the movie. But considering its his very first movie need to appreciate him for his efforts!!!

There was no scope for any other actors in the movie except for Kalyan Ram and though he put all the efforts to carry the movie on his shoulders but he couldn’t make complete justification…Nevertheless Great effort from him!!!

Most of the Keeravani’s BGM resembled Bahubali & RRR…

I believe the Low/Medium Budget + Proper Release Timing (as Tollywood was producing poor content till then) + proper Publicity helped the movie to become a BLOCKBUSTER which otherwise could have been an above Average movie

v: I hate love stories... and still came out calling this a CLASSIC ❤️ Sita Ramam got almost everything right. Wife was right to drag me into the theatre 😄
e: Sita Ramam overcame probably the biggest obstacle possible for a romance: me 😄 I went in reluctantly, expecting another love story, and was completely absorbed from the opening titles. Hanu Raghavapudi’s world, Dulquer and Mrunal’s chemistry, the writing, music and visual craft combine into one of those rare romantic films I was genuinely glad not to miss on the big screen.
body:
Finally Watched #SitaRamam : before I start, I hate Love stories and Gautham Menon’s Romantic movies are big let down for me and I slept during those classics as I go to Theatre just for my wife 🙂

Having Said that which was the last Romantic movie I loved the most…..it was Malli Malli Idhi Rani Roju, which I still regret of not watching in Big screen…..and I am glad that I didn’t miss watching this CLASSIC!!!!

Though I was already aware of the rave reviews for this movie….I was reluctant to watch it as I was considering it as yet another love story and my wife forced me to just because of her LOVE towards Dulquer Salmaan….and I am

glad that I bowed to her insistence

Once the Titles started I was completely involved into the beautiful world of Sita & Ram…This film is an example of perfect match of Great Content, Great Casting, Great Acting, Great Dialogues, Great BGM, Great Locations, Great Direction and Great Production!!!!

Below are glimpse of some meaningful and impactful dialogues from the movie :

1. ayinaa ipudu neeku kavalsindhi mana vaalu kadhu sayam chese vaalu 🙏🙏

2. Ayudham tho yudham chesevadu sanikudu anni..dharmam tho chesevadu ramudu anni

3. Nuvu Vinadhi Nijam kaadu….Naminadhe Nijam

The way the director dealt with so called sensitive topics and the way Sumanth’s characterisation is written is simply EXCELLENT!!!

Swapna Dutt is bringing back the glory of her Father’s production house in great style!!!

I totally loved the movie…..though my kid didn’t enjoy it much and considered it slow and boring because there is no action 😉

v: Standalone ga above-average drug-mafia movie. But as the start of Lokesh universe madness? Much more fun 😄 Kamal + Fahadh + VJS + Anirudh BGM do the heavy lifting.
e: Vikram is elevated far above its basic drug-mafia story by powerhouse performances and Anirudh’s terrific score. The first half felt confusing and initially made the hype seem excessive, but the way Lokesh Kanagaraj connects the pieces in the second half — and expands the Kaithi universe — is where the film becomes genuinely exciting.
body:
An above average Drug Mafia based movie…elevated by top notch performances by Kamal Hasan, Fahadh Faasil, Vijay Sethupathi and others…and a terrific BGM by Anirudh 🙏🙏🙏 The BGM haunts you even several hours after the movie….If considered as a standalone movie, then its a one time watch, but Lokesh’s vision to expand this universe gives us the small kicks to link with Khaidi and other future parts….hopefully the director fully explores all the chars which are rushed and not properly justified…..

First half is bit confusing and I felt that the movie was over hyped….but the way things unfolded in second half is the brilliance of the director!!!

A Must Watch for fans of Khaidi….
